d: After T launches a successful business using one of Kim and Nikki’s favorite sayings, all three of them wind up in court.
The Grim Reaper turns Kim’s birthday bash into the ultimate fright fest.
Nikki and Kim square off in a campus election.
Kim puts her own spin on the legendary television show, 'Dallas,'  by imagining her family and friends as the twisted characters from the primetime series of lust and greed.
After a minor spat with Nikki gets blown way out of proportion, Kim spendsThanksgiving alone.
Nikki tries out for cheerleading and Professor Oglevee tries too hard to be hip.
If you think Nikki’s wild about Professor Oglevee, wait till you meet her grandmother!
Nikki uncovers a shocking secret about her family, while Kim and Stevie try to live without the use of African-American inventions.
Nikki fears that Kim may have been switched at birth, and the Professor’s late uncle has a tough time resting in peace.
Nikki and the handsome new Pastor of her church make beautiful music together.
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends are stranded during their employee picnic and retreat.
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.
Malcolm's good luck streak is matched bad Eddie's sudden run of bad fortune.
To fix a leaky roof, the bank loan officer forces Malcolm to hire his daughter.
Stiff competition inspires Malcolm and Eddie to turn McGee's into a casino.
Malcolm and his sister vie for the attention of the same woman.

st: A Police Officer And A Gentleman
d: Eddie is jealous when Nicolette agrees to accompany her commander to a police department dance.
Following her divorce, Eddie's mom arrives for a visit that coincides with one from Malcolm's dad.
Malcolm and Eddie decide to settle an argument by trading jobs for a day.
Malcolm faces a difficult decision in order to get Simone to keep making her extraordinary cookies.
Torn between her two worlds, Joan struggles with her professional duty while at the same time dealing with the guilt that she is not being true to herself or her beliefs.

Maya buys a dress that is too expensive knowing it might cause problems with her husband, Darnell. Joan treats herself to a trip to New York to visit her boyfriend, realizing the distance between the two of them is a problem.

Joan ends the friendship between her and Toni after finding out that Toni has been discussing her personal life with co-workers behind her back. Meanwhile, Lynn is trying to cope with her new living situation with Vosco, and his lack of a job.

Yvonne is concerned that William is never going to marry her because they have not set a date for the wedding. When Yvonne asks Joan for advice, Joan tries her best to stay out of it but ends up telling Yvonne to move in with William first to try it out.
For her thirtieth birthday, Joan finds that she is happy with who she is, yet finds that she’s not so happy that her father is a nudist.
When Toni loses her friend Joan, her man, and her gold card, it’s up to Maya and Lynn to help her get her life back together.
Due to marital tensions at home, an emotionally fragile Maya finds herself falling into a fantasy affair with a handsome and empathetic new friend, Stan.
Toni meets a great man but is dumped after she’s a bad influence on his eight-year-old daughter. Joan dates a movie star but is dumped when he begins to think she’s stalking him.
Maya refuses to end her relationship with Stan, despite her girlfriends' repeated warnings to do so.
As a gesture of his love, William buys a beautiful house for his fiance, Yvonne.
Lynn's Caucasian sister, Tanya, travels to LA to help Lynn celebrate her Gotcha Day: the day when Lynn's childhood adoption to her Caucasian family became legal.

st: Willie or Won’t He II: The Last Chapter
d: The week of William and Yvonne's wedding is finally here and all goes smoothly until Yvonne discovers William never told his mother about Yvonne...ever.
Moesha is sentenced to do errands for an old woman who lives down the block because she stole oranges from her tree.
